newsitem.title: ITALY: ISTAT head sees positive sign from industry in GDP.
newsitem.headline: ISTAT head sees positive sign from industry in GDP.

text.p: Italian economic growth data released earlier on Friday contains a positive signal as far as industry is concerned, Alberto Zuliani, the head of national statistics institute ISTAT, said.
Italian gross domestic product (GDP) rose a provisional 0.5 percent year-on-year in the third quarter of this year, compared with 0.7 percent growth in the second quarter.
Third quarter growth versus the second quarter was 0.5 percent after a 0.4 percent contraction in the previous three month period.
"There is some recovery, even if it is limited to 0.5 percent, and in any case there is a positive signal -- from industry which is not going too badly," Zuliani told reporters at a meeting.
"In order to have more complete data we must wait for the final figures which usually aren't revised," he said.
Final GDP data are published by ISTAT January 7.
